author: Shreyas Gupta
complements: Ionic_Portfolio_Review (the deep reference for the scoring chain itself)
changes: run_review.py builds the CLIENT workbook too. Left as a separate command it was a step somebody forgets, and forgetting it attaches the raw reconciliation frame - raw field headings, and rationale text naming the firm own model - to a client email.
SKILL.md names the two workbooks apart: <Client>_Portfolio_Workbook.xlsx goes out, <Client>_Holdings.xlsx reconciles and does not.

Capture ratios: export_score_file.py now publishes up_capture / down_capture / capture_months / capture_ref, computed from the same monthly NAV panel as the score against the scheme own SEBI-category peer average. Four modules had read those fields since the kit was written and got None on every build, so the equity fund page skipped its capture panel and the per-scheme scorecards printed a dash.

qa/check_sync.py warns on a STARVED column - one the deck reads and the published file does not carry. A self-gating page renders nothing, which on a finished deck is indistinguishable from a page the desk chose not to include.

run_review.py: one command for build + graft + all three gates, exiting non-zero on any finding that lands on a generated page and writing out/<Client>_RUN.json so a deck can be traced back to its inputs and score-file dates.
qa/check_sync.py: one command that says whether the score files, the band files, the concentration cap, the skill and the git tree actually agree. Run it before any client build.
One skill for the whole review pipeline: statement in, deck and reconciling workbook out.
Documents the ionic-deck-kit path (statement -> build_review.py) as primary; the hand-written pr_template ctx path is the legacy route.
references/03_client_directives.md: the overlay that records a client's own instructions without the firm's name landing on calls it never made.
references/04_tax.md: the lot-aware tax engine - LTCG / STCG / post-Apr-2023 slices, equity STCG at 20%, slab money disclosed and never estimated.
references/08_do_not_regress.md: every defect this deck has shipped once, each of which passed all three QA gates.

Corrects the repo-visibility claim: shreyas1gupta-wq/ionic-scorecard is PUBLIC (verified 2026-09-08 via the GitHub API). Score files, band files, VERSION.json and every client artefact are gitignored and must stay that way.
notes: sequence is the field compared for staleness; version is for humans.
